  director = 'Joss Whedon',
  cast = 'Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark / Iron Man, Chris Evans as Steve Rogers / Captain America, Chris Hemsworth as Thor, Mark Ruffalo as Bruce Banner / Hulk, Scarlett Johansson as Natasha Romanoff / Black Widow, Jeremy Renner as Clint Barton / Hawkeye, James Spader as Ultron (voice), Elizabeth Olsen as Wanda Maximoff / Scarlet Witch, Aaron Taylor-Johnson as Pietro Maximoff / Quicksilver, Paul Bettany as Vision',
  tagline = 'A new age begins.',
  description = 'When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it''s up to Earth''s Mightiest Heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan. Along the way, the team encounters two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/avengers-age-of-ultron-2015-featured-STPnozeCJTEagY3CttxHcN.webp',
  youtubeTrailerId = 'tmeOjFno6Do',

  rtAudienceScore = 83,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Age of Ultron: New Heroes, New Cards

Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015) introduced several characters who would become central to the MCU''s future — Scarlet Witch, Vision, and Quicksilver. For card collectors, this film''s sets represent the debut of characters whose values have only grown over time.

### Key Sets

The **2015 Upper Deck Avengers: Age of Ultron** set features the full ensemble cast with autographs from newcomers Elizabeth Olsen, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, and James Spader. The set also includes the first Vision cards featuring Paul Bettany in the role.

### Market Trends

Elizabeth Olsen (Scarlet Witch) autograph cards from this set have skyrocketed in value following WandaVision and Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. James Spader Ultron autographs are undervalued given his iconic voice performance. Vision/Paul Bettany cards are rising due to the character''s emotional arc through WandaVision.',
  keyCards = '- **Elizabeth Olsen as Scarlet Witch First Auto** — Her MCU debut card, now extremely valuable ($3,000+)
- **James Spader as Ultron Autograph** — Iconic villain, undervalued ($800+)
- **Paul Bettany as Vision First Auto** — Character''s debut, WandaVision boosted value ($1,200+)
- **Aaron Taylor-Johnson as Quicksilver Auto** — Only MCU appearance makes this scarce ($600+)
- **Robert Downey Jr. Age of Ultron Auto** — Premium RDJ card ($5,000+)
- **2015 Upper Deck Age of Ultron Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 team artwork',
  content = '## The Avengers Expand

Avengers: Age of Ultron was the most ambitious MCU film to date when it released — a $365 million production that juggled the original six Avengers while introducing Scarlet Witch, Quicksilver, Vision, and the titular villain Ultron. While it didn''t quite match the original''s cultural impact, it grossed $1.4 billion and set up the MCU''s future in crucial ways.

## The Legacy

- **Introduced Scarlet Witch** — Elizabeth Olsen''s Wanda Maximoff became one of the MCU''s most powerful and complex characters
- **Created Vision** — Paul Bettany''s android hero became central to WandaVision
- **Set Up Civil War** — The Sokovia Accords and Tony/Steve tension directly led to the next Captain America film
- **The Hulkbuster Fight** — Iron Man vs. Hulk remains one of the MCU''s most spectacular action sequences
- **Quicksilver''s Sacrifice** — Aaron Taylor-Johnson''s only MCU appearance made it memorable

## Fun Facts

- James Spader performed all of Ultron''s scenes on set in a motion capture suit, not just voice recording
- The Hulkbuster sequence took over a year to complete in post-production
- Joss Whedon has said this was the hardest filmmaking experience of his career
- The party scene where everyone tries to lift Thor''s hammer was largely improvised
- Elizabeth Olsen and Aaron Taylor-Johnson developed their own twin language for their scenes together

## Viewing Context

Avengers: Age of Ultron is the **eleventh MCU film** and the fifth entry in Phase 2. It brings the Avengers back together after the events of their individual Phase 2 films. The post-credits scene shows Thanos putting on the Infinity Gauntlet, directly setting up the Infinity War storyline.',
  metaDescription = 'Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015) MCU guide — $1.4B box office, Scarlet Witch debut, Vision origin, and trading card market analysis for collectors.',
  keywords = 'Avengers Age of Ultron, MCU Phase 2, Scarlet Witch, Vision, Ultron, Elizabeth Olsen, trading cards, Marvel cards, box office, billion dollar',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Topps Marvel Avengers Ultron cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Avengers: Age of Ultron on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015) is available on Disney+. It is the eleventh MCU film and the fifth entry in Phase 2, featuring the debut of Scarlet Witch, Vision, and Quicksilver."},{"question":"How much did Age of Ultron make at the box office?","answer":"Avengers: Age of Ultron grossed $1.403 billion worldwide against a $365 million budget. It earned $191 million opening weekend domestically and $459 million total in North America."},{"question":"Who are the new Avengers in Age of Ultron?","answer":"Age of Ultron introduces Scarlet Witch (Elizabeth Olsen), Quicksilver (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), and Vision (Paul Bettany). By the end, the team roster expands to include War Machine, Falcon, Scarlet Witch, and Vision alongside the original members."},{"question":"What Age of Ultron cards are most valuable?","answer":"Elizabeth Olsen Scarlet Witch debut autos ($3,000+) lead the market following WandaVision. Paul Bettany Vision first autos ($1,200+) and James Spader Ultron autos ($800+) are also highly sought. RDJ autos from this set command $5,000+."},{"question":"Why is Age of Ultron important to the MCU?","answer":"It introduces Scarlet Witch and Vision (central to WandaVision), creates the Sokovia Accords conflict that drives Civil War, and its post-credits scene with Thanos directly sets up the Infinity War/Endgame saga. It also marks the last time the original six Avengers work together harmoniously."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'avengers-age-of-ultron-2015'
